seq_of_zeros.description: array_like, shape (N,) or (N, N) A sequence of polynomial roots, or a square array or matrix object.
constraints: If input is the wrong shape (the input must be a 1-D or square)

output.description: ------- ndarray 1D array of polynomial coefficients from highest to lowest degree: ``c[0] * x**(N) + c[1] * x**(N-1) + ... + c[N-1] * x + c[N]`` where c[0] always equals 1.
